'''Kes''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn system]],<ref name="TT" /> within the [[Zeemacht Cluster/Legends|Zeemacht Cluster]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Kes occupied the fifth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Tirahnn (star)|Tirahnn]] and had no [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. It featured a [[Water/Legends|frozen]] rock surface and [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] climate.<ref name="TT" /> Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], the planet was located on the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]], which in the Inner Rim served as the dividing line between the regions known as the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kes was mentioned in "[[Triplet Threat]]," a [[roleplaying game]] adventure written by [[Jason Fry]] for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. It was published on the company's [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[January 22]], [[2004]].<ref name="TT" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Tirahnn system, and therefore Kes, in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
